item.title: [DE|Local] BR24 Thema des Tages (Bayern) (Fri 19:00): Warnstreiks bei der IG Metall: Wie Zukunftsängste der Beschäftigten die Tarifverhandlungen überschatten
item.description:
Originally published Fri 06 Nov 2026 19:00 IST.
Die Gewerkschaft IG Metall erhöht den Druck auf die Arbeitgeber und hat zehntausende Beschäftigte in Bayern zu Warnsstreiks aufgerufen. Allein im Raum Nürnberg gilt das für etwa 30 Betriebe. ZF, Siemens, MAN und Schaeffler zum Beispiel. Vor dem Tor des Bosch-Werks in Nürnberg gab es eine Kundgebung. Mit unserem Tarifexperten schauen wir genauer auf die Verhandlungen, die großen Probleme in der Zulieferer-Branche und auf einen möglichen neuen wirtschaftspolitischen Ansatz im Land. Moderation: Jörg Brandscheidt

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Sat 14:00): The Happy Pod: Celebrating the wedding that never happened
item.description:
Originally published Sat 07 Nov 2026 14:00 IST.

When Bridget's relationship fell apart, she turned to the internet with a proposal: come to Northern Ireland and celebrate the wedding that never happened. What followed was a story that has resonated worldwide as 11 strangers answered the call and helped transform loss and heartbreak into an unforgettable week of connection, companionship and adventure.

Also on this podcast; meet the 25-year-old who is on a mission to give one million people access to safe water by 2030. Diana Virgovicova was diagnosed with ovarian cancer as a teenager -- a disease which she believes was linked to the use of agricultural pesticides in her town. After she realised contaminated water was a global problem, she taught herself quantum chemistry to find a way to clean up water.

Also, the family living on the UK's most remote inhabited island and we go to Washington DC's annual High Heel Race.

Picture: Eleven strangers from across the world travelled to Northern Ireland to celebrate Bridget's 'non-wedding'. Credit: Rob Dight / Epic Love Photography

Our weekly collection of inspiring, uplifting and happy news from around the world.

Presenter: Holly Gibbs. Music composed by Iona Hampson
